text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Coming up in the latter half of February, we're continuing our preparations for the Yayoi Sho in the cold weather.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haah… Haah…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Wow, look at Spe. That tire she's pulling is huge.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes. Recently, she's also been going out running in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I wonder why she's training like that…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh! Suzuka! Hey!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um, do you wanna do some partner running with me after training today?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka agrees, and the two of them go partner running after our session.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week chases after Silence Suzuka with all her might, but Silence Suzuka manages to keep ahead without breaking much of a sweat.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Urgh… Guess I'm still not ready. I gotta work harder…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: …Hey, Spe—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, Spe! You out here partner running again?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hi, Sei. Yeah, just a little. Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Again"?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Lately, she's been out here every day, partner running with just about anyone, even though it's after training hours.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Don't burn yourself out, all right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thanks, I won't. See you later.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phew… All right, Suzuka. How about one more—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Agh!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: A-ahaha… I lost feeling in my legs.
choice_data_list: Don't you think you've been working a little too hard?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?! No! Not at all!
choice_data_list: Proper rest is just as important as training, you know.
Proper rest is just as important as training, you know.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah… I'm sorry for worrying you…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hey, Spe…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Why are you doing all of this?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You've been at it nonstop, running morning and night, even after training…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So much so that you nearly fainted just now…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Why are you pushing yourself like this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a simple question, and although initially met with pause, it doesn't seem as though she has anything to hide.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um… Well…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wanna make my dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Your dream?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But right now, I'm not good enough.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's why I've been trying so hard every day—to get better!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Every day, bit by bit, I'm trying to get closer to becoming the top Umamusume in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So, yeah… In a nutshell, that's it… Huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh… I'm sorry, I was just a little surprised.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (That huge tire… Early morning running… Evening partner running… How hard she was trying to catch up to me…)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (All to make her dream come true…)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (Are all the others like this too?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Silence Suzuka convinces the exhausted Special Week to return to their dorm before the sun fully sets.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, there's a scrimmage on the academy grounds.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unsurprisingly, Silence Suzuka manages to take first. However…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ugh! I couldn't catch up again!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Why?! After everything… After all the work I've done!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Sob…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This isn't the first time Silence Suzuka has found herself surrounded by Umamusume devastated by their failure to keep up with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But until now, she didn't pay them any mind—or rather, she didn't even notice it happening.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now, a change has begun to occur within her.
